review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines three kernels: weightedKernel, normalizedKernel and diagonalReplacementKernel. I searched Mathlib/Probability/Kernel for mixture or weighted constructions and found none. Mathlib has Kernel.sum, Kernel.sum_fintype, the Finset sum of kernels, constant-scalar smul, and Kernel.withDensity. Kernel.withDensity with a density that is constant in y could express weightedKernel, as ∑ i, withDensity (κ i) (fun x _ => w i x). That route needs an IsSFiniteKernel assumption and gives a different, less direct API. The target takes arbitrary kernels and only measurable weights, so it is not an independent copy of an existing concept. Other normalizedKernel and weightedKernel definitions in the repo are unrelated (real-valued kernels in other domains). normalizedKernel only composes weightedKernel with normalised weights, and diagonalReplacementKernel is a specific instance. These are named specialisations, so I found no justified duplication finding.
